# Polybelle Event Halls & Studio

> Polybelle is an events management company in Abu Dhabi, UAE, with three event halls (Electra Street and Al Wahda) and a photo studio. It hosts birthdays, weddings, engagements, baby showers, gender reveals, debuts, anniversaries, cake smash shoots, seminars and corporate events, and provides full packages: styling, catering, customized cakes, photo and video, photobooth, mascots and souvenirs. It can also bring its packages to hotels, villas, parks and homes anywhere in Abu Dhabi.

Website: https://www.polybelle.me
Book online: https://www.polybelle.me/#book (no payment needed to send a request; confirmed on WhatsApp)
Phone / WhatsApp: +971 52 865 3208, +971 54 557 9880
Languages: English, Filipino, Arabic
Payment: Visa, Mastercard; pay later with Tabby or Tamara

## Halls (all in Abu Dhabi)
- Hall A and Hall B (same building): 603, 6th Floor, Tower B (Metro Manila / Global Studio Building), Electra Street, behind City Seasons Hotel. Hall A up to 70 guests, Hall B up to 30, or Hall A&B (both rooms together) up to 100. Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/iGwjTLTESVSD1wGN6
- Hall C: 1802, 18th Floor, C88 Commercial Tower A (AST Trading / dnata Travel Building), Electra Street, behind City Seasons Hotel. Up to 60 guests. Map: https://share.google/n6CTvTV2nUmjItbyQ
- Hall D (Al Wahda): Mezzanine 1, Building No. 156 (Phil Greenhouse Cosmetics Building), beside Best Chicken, opposite Al Wahda Mall. Up to 50 guests. Map: https://g.co/kgs/73F8P3G
- Other venues: Polybelle styles and runs events at the customer's own hotel, villa, park, home or other venue.

## Booking sessions
- Afternoon: 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM
- Evening: 6:00 PM onwards
Live availability for each hall is shown on the website ("Check availability").

## Packages and services
Full celebration packages, wedding packages, event styling and balloon decorations, catering and party food, customized cakes and dessert tables, photo and video coverage, professional host, photobooth, mascot surprise, scent and DIY craft stations, customized souvenirs (direct supplier, bulk orders), face painting, video and audio guestbooks. Photo studio: newborn, pre-birthday and prenup shoots.

## Wedding support
Wedding packages plus help with court registration, MOFA attestation, Report of Marriage, gown and suit rental, and hair and makeup.
